voices.description: Every part's published versions (each names its partKey), each part's default first, as the catalogue's versions.

grant.description: Why the caller may have it: a free song, Plus, the song of the month, kept from a project started while it was, their own template, an unlisted template's link, or a choir group's song, or a project they sing in made from it; Hillel or the editor reviewing; or a beta singer's assigned song. public: a template listed in the library (N3). idea: a tune shared as an idea, while it's listed.

freeUntil.description: The song of the month's last moment (for grant month).

library.description: Only for a public template (N3): its creator, for the credits in exports, and its uses and rating.
